description: The principal's published bounds — what depths and urgencies they accept right now, on what cadence. Senders' scribes are expected to read this before composing. Per Ballestiero p67 (`Goals do not cascade. Bounds propagate.`): the attentionEnvelope IS the propagated bound.

signer.description: The principal whose bounds these are.

depthsAccepted.description: Depths the principal will accept right now. Empty = none accepted.

urgenciesAccepted.description: Urgencies the principal will accept. Empty = none accepted.

cadence.description: Free-form description of when the principal reads the inbox (e.g. `weekday mornings, 09:00–10:00 GMT`). Future versions may structure this.

overrideChannel.description: How to reach the principal outside the cadence (e.g. `phone call`). The override is a social contract, not a protocol-level mechanism.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the last bound update.
